text: Assumption: CRYIF_E_UNINIT applies analogously to all services before CryIf_Init — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: CRYIF_E_UNINIT applies analogously to all services before CryIf_Init — is this correct?
norm: cryif_e_uninit applies analogously to all services before cryif_init
assumption: CRYIF_E_UNINIT applies analogously to all services before CryIf_Init.
rationale: Attested in the payload for KeyDerive, RandomSeed, CancelJob, KeyGetStatus, and CallbackNotification; SWS_CryIf_00009 describes the error generally as "API request called before initialisation".

original.text: Annahme: CRYIF_E_UNINIT gilt analog für alle Dienste vor CryIf_Init — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: im Payload für KeyDerive, RandomSeed, CancelJob, KeyGetStatus und CallbackNotification belegt; SWS_CryIf_00009 beschreibt den Fehler allgemein als „API request called before initialisation“.
